scope.summary: Windows audit instability root-caused: (1) REAL product defect fixed: DurableShippingForwarder::flush() could be lost between a failed delivery and the worker parking for its retry backoff (lost wakeup; worker slept the full backoff); fixed with a flush_requested flag bridged through the queue mutex, consumed before parking. (2) shutdown_budget_includes_waiting_for_the_queue_mutex was a timing assumption, pinned deterministically. (3) sink.rs Windows failure was a test-setup race (helper now signals over a pipe). Liveness-only deadlines use one named 30s hang guard where the eventual outcome is still asserted (7b2f9942).
out_of_scope: Windows lint warnings in untouched code are tracked as oraclemcp-aer4w.
